// note: Manual pages for this pack's own commands. `man` looks in the engine's registry first and falls back to here, so for a pack command this file is what a student reads -- the `man` block in commands.js is not consulted. Keep the two saying the same thing.

map.name: map - display virtual filesystem topography
map.description: Renders an ASCII diagram of the filesystem from live VFS nodes.

// evtrace: act3-man sends the student here for a real reason: they need an option they do not know, and OPTIONS is where a tool says what it can do. The find is the bench's tool-use record, which is chain of custody rather than a scavenger-hunt token bolted on.

evtrace.name: evtrace - replay recorded evidence activity
evtrace.description:
Bench utility that replays recorded activity from the exhibits on this workstation.

By default it replays one source. See OPTIONS below for the option that replays every recorded source instead.

This bench logs every tool it runs against an exhibit by the reference printed in that tool's manual page. The reference for this build is [[FLAG:act3-man]].

// mmls: Was called `scan`, which exists on no real machine. mmls is Sleuth Kit: subject knowledge, so the pack owns it. Its partner `extract -o` was dd in a costume and is gone; dd is coreutils and belongs to the engine, which now has it.

mmls.name: mmls - display the partition layout of a volume system
mmls.description:
Prints the partition table of a disk image: the sector each partition starts at, the sector it ends at, and what kind of partition it is. It reads the image and writes nothing to it. Part of the Sleuth Kit.

The start sector it prints is the number `dd skip=` wants, when the block size is one sector.
